evidence.limits: No whisper.srt existed when coded. All speech comes from burned-in captions: hook 0-5 s complete at 4 fps, later captions sampled once a second so words can be missing. Roles of the three-way framing (what the numbers 7, 13, 16, 24 and 60 on the whiteboard stand for) are only visible as drawing, the caption does not explain them in frames seen; the lecture's earlier parts are not shown. Cut count is the ffmpeg figure. Some insert clips (news anchors, bomb damage, a film scene) are identified only by what is visible, sources not verified. Speech fields checked against the transcript on 09 Nov 2026 (text-only pass).

topic_detail: Lecture clip on how to hold attention in Instagram stories: do not post one long story, give the audience small pieces step by step (the 'Level Up' idea); starts with a story of going to a pizzeria that he thinks is reasonable but is told 'stop watching the news'.
audience: business owners and aspiring business owners who post on Instagram (the lecture was to 400 business owners according to the caption).
caption_vs_video_note: Caption matches: a continuation of yesterday's video about increasing 'the guarantee' (apparently the story views/commitment) in stories, from a lecture to 400 business owners. The video opens with a 'true story' about a pizzeria and news that only reaches the story-posting point at about 42 s, so the first 40 s look like a different topic (news, pizza, degree and a famous founder).

opening.first_frame: A glowing orange light-leak over Matan on stage in a white shirt with his arm raised, the caption 'סיפור אמיתי' (the cover, by contrast, shows him with hands at his ears and the caption 'אתם צריכים להבין').
opening.s0_1: Light-leak transition at 0 s; 'סיפור אמיתי' then 'שקרה אתמול:' (about 0.4 s) as he walks across the stage; cut at 1.08 s to a wide-angle audience shot.
opening.s1_3: Audience shot of men and women in red seats (1.08-3.3 s) with the captions 'הלכתי לפיצה שאני אוכל שם' and 'כבר עשור!'.
opening.s3_5: Back to Matan, mid-shot (3.3 s) with 'מהאלה שאין להם שם לחנות', a photo inset of a pizzeria sign 'הפיצה' appears at 3.5 s, green caption 'הפיצה' at 4.75 s.
opening.visual_hook: Stage shot with a light-leak transition, then audience cutaways and an inset photo of a pizza shop sign.
opening.spoken_hook: Spoken from 0 s (machine transcript): 'סיפור אמיתי שקרה אתמול, הלכתי לפיצה שאני אוכל שם כבר [עשור]' (0-3.2 s); matches the captions.
opening.text_hook: סיפור אמיתי / שקרה אתמול: / הלכתי לפיצה / שאני אוכל שם / כבר עשור!
opening.first_sentence_standalone: yes: 'a true story that happened yesterday: I went to the pizza place I have been eating at for ten years' is complete, but it does not signal the topic (stories/attention).
opening.number_or_money_in_first_3s: no (a decade, 'כבר עשור', is a duration only)
opening.works_without_sound: mostly: captions carry the speech; the numbers on the whiteboard need the audio.

visual.subject_placement: Matan roughly centred, full body to waist on a dark stage, walking and gesturing; captions at about 55% of the frame height.
visual.setting: A black-box stage with a flip chart (whiteboard) with drawings (60 with bars 7, 13, 16, 24), a lavalier and headset mic; an audience in red seats; extra inserts.
visual.lighting: Stage spotlight, black background, white outfit.
visual.color_contrast: White clothes against black; some shots in black and white for quotes; red, green and yellow caption emphasis.
visual.props_and_gestures: Flip chart with drawn bars and red circles around numbers (7 at 43 s and 58 s, 24 at 1:00), walking, pointing, hands raised near the head (cover).
visual.supporting_footage: Audience cutaways (1-3 s, 22-24 s, 1:08-1:11 s), two news anchors (7-9 s), photo of a pizza sign (3.5-5 s), a front-of-camera clip of explosion damage to cars and buildings (24.5-27.5 s), a film scene of a young man in a hooded sweatshirt (32-36 s, the Facebook-founder film look, not verified), a stage view from behind (36-39 s), his own phone selfie clips in tank top (50-55 s, 1:13-1:19 s), news chart N12 (53 s), cartoon child with many devices (1:06-1:07 s), a text-box screenshot 'עלות שקועה' (29-31 s).
visual.faces_blurred: no (audience members, the news anchors and the film actor are identifiable)
visual.visual_progression: 0-3 s stage and audience; 3.3-6 s stage with a pizza photo; 7-9 s news anchors; 10-17 s black and white stage clips for quotes, colour at 14 s; 18-20 s flip chart; 21 s stage; 22-24 s audience; 24.5-27.5 s damaged cars; 28-31 s stage with 'sunk cost' text box; 32-36 s film scene; 36-39 s view from behind to an audience; 40-47 s stage and chart; 50-55 s phone selfie clips; 56-1:05 s stage and chart; 1:06-1:07 s cartoon inset; 1:08-1:11 s audience; 1:13-1:19 s selfie clips; 1:20-1:22 s stage.
visual.cover_matches_video: partly: the cover is a stage frame with the caption 'אתם צריכים להבין', which does not appear in the frames seen (it may be a different moment).
visual.ui_interference: Captions at about 50-60% of the frame; text boxes at 50-55 s (red and purple boxes at 30-45% and 75-90%) and the 'תצפו עד סוף הסרטון!' box at 1:18 (about 70% down) reach the bottom overlay zone; a red text box at the very top (50-51 s) touches the top zone.

editing.edit_function: Information and stimulation: inserts illustrate each phrase of the story (news anchors for 'stop watching the news', bomb damage for 'news about…', a film scene for 'a guy doing a degree for 3 years'), circles on the flip chart direct attention, black and white marks quoted speech, a 'LEVEL UP' sticker at 1:16.
pacing_changes: t=0-9 s: a new shot every 1-3 s (stage, audience, pizza, anchors)
t=10-17 s: four black and white shots in quote mode
t=18-20 s: the flip chart with ticks held 3 s
t=50-55 s: sped-up selfie clips with colourful text boxes
editing.ending: At 1:20-1:22 s he is on stage with captions 'שהם יצפו ואנשים עושים את מה שאומרים להם' (the Reel is cut after 82.9 s); before it a selfie clip with 'תצפו עד סוף הסרטון!' at 1:18.
editing.rewatch_reasons: Interpretation: dense inserts and quick captions give a lot to catch, and the pizzeria story and the numbers on the flip chart reward a second view.

sound.delivery: Lecture pace with an energetic voice, projected over a headset mic. Loudness is -16 to -30 dB across the whole Reel with dips of about 1-2 s that look like phrase pauses; the machine transcript shows near-continuous speech from 0 to 82.9 s.
sound.sync: Captions follow phrases (about 1-1.5 s each); inserts land on the caption word (news anchors on 'לצפות בחדשות', damaged cars on 'גרפיים'); the flip chart circles come when the number is named.

text.colour_coding: White base; yellow for quoted speech in black and white shots (e.g. 'אני מצטער שצפיתי בדבר הזה!'); red for emphasis or negatives ('חמאב?', 'גרפיים', 'כל מיני שקרים כאלה...', 'קח 60 שניות', 'זה לא עובד!'); green for positive words ('בקטן!', 'זה לא רק בזה!', 'להאכיל אותם בכפית!').
text.style: Bold white sans-serif with a dark outline, no box; extra coloured boxes in the selfie clips (red, purple, white) and a white card for the 'עלות שקועה' definition.
text.density_and_read_time: Short phrases of 2-5 words changing about every second; easy to read except the small card and the selfie text boxes.
text.language: Colloquial, short sentences, direct address ('תפסיק לצפות בחדשות!'), jokes ('הפיצה'), one marketing term ('עלות שקועה'), English 'LEVEL UP'.
text.caption_structure: Three lines with emojis: it continues yesterday's video on increasing stories' 'מערבות', advice 'give them in small pieces, step by step', and a credit line that the clip is from a lecture to 400 business owners. No hashtags, no CTA.
text.rtl_notes: Hebrew captions render correctly; mixed numbers and fractions ('1/6', '2/6', '60', '7 13 16 24') and English 'LEVEL UP' sit fine; the last text boxes in the selfie clip are cut off at the left edge.

story.setup: A pizzeria anecdote from yesterday (the owner regrets watching a news report, the 'painful part' came 9 minutes in, so he kept watching: sunk cost), then a degree example and the point about 60-second stories.
story.stakes: People's attention in stories: a long story loses people.
story.progression: Anecdote and quotes (0-17 s), the pizzeria owner's news report and sunk cost (17-31 s), a person dying to drop out of a 3-year degree who says 'only one more year left' (33-41 s), then 'I start small, not 60 seconds in your face for people with low attention' (42-50 s), 'I fight for every moment in a story', start small and work to the end (50-60 s), 'people do not have long attention, hold them in small pieces' (65-70 s), the 'one of four, two of four' markers (72-76 s), and 'watch to the end' as a tactic (77-82 s).
story.payoff: The advice: give people the content in small parts, step by step, 'more than 60 seconds' is too long for a single story.
story.resolution: Spoken close (machine transcript, 77-82 s): 'sometimes I tell them: watch to the end, because I want them to watch to the end, and people do what they are told'.
story.payoff_delivered: partly: the topic-relevant advice arrives only after about 42-50 s and the 1:18 text 'תצפו עד סוף הסרטון' stays unexplained in the frames; the Reel is a continuation of another Reel, so it is partly dependent on it.
friction_points: t=0-40 s: the opening anecdote (pizza, news, degree) does not state the topic of stories (interpretation)
t=24-27 s: war damage footage used for a joke about news may jar or be read as insensitive (interpretation)
t=50-55 s: dense colourful selfie boxes are hard to read at speed (interpretation)
t=1:08-1:11 s: audience footage held for 4 s with no new picture (interpretation)

explicit_prompts.wording: 'תצפו עד סוף הסרטון!' on screen at 78 s; spoken at 77-80 s as an example of a tactic he uses in stories ('צפו עד הסוף'), machine transcript

engagement.comment_notes: Sample of 12 top-level comments, not representative. Mostly praise ('גאון שיווקי', 'תוכן זהב'); one jokes on 'אדון עם קשב וריכוז נמוך', two push back on his stance on degrees ('חסר לאיש הזה תואר אקדמי', 'יש מקצועות שחייב תואר'), one says 'צפיתי פה עד הסוף'.
engagement.creator_reply_pattern: none seen (no own comments in the sample; about 5 comments show 1 reply, author not stored)

conversion.cta_fits_content: n/a: no CTA besides the on-screen 'watch to the end'.

rights_and_privacy: Third-party footage: two news anchors, damaged cars and buildings, and a film scene (yes); audience members at his own event, news anchors and actors identifiable and not blurred (yes); no minors visible except a cartoon. Copying this would need own event footage and licensed or no news footage.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: a recorded stage lecture with big gestures plus inserts every 1-3 s keeps the picture moving, the colour-coded captions make the speech readable without sound, and the pizzeria story gives a concrete anecdote before the lesson. Being a continuation of a previous Reel may attract returning viewers.
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: low comment and share ratios (0.2 comments and 0.7 shares per 1,000 views), no CTA and an 83 s length with the topic stated only after about 40 s; the sources of some footage may feel off-topic.

standout_moments.what: Light-leak and 'סיפור אמיתי שקרה אתמול' opens as an anecdote, a story hook, but the topic is not named.
News anchors say 'תפסיק לצפות בחדשות!' (captions) as a visual punchline to the pizzeria story.
Red circle on the small bar of the flip chart drawn as 'בקטן!' makes the idea visible.
Cartoon child with a phone, spinner and burger illustrates 'people have no long attention' in one image.
On-screen 'תצפו עד סוף הסרטון!' in his own selfie style, a watch-to-end prompt late in the Reel.
